run_moses_preprocess_module: run Moses preprocessing on text shards using MosesPreprocessModule with a MosesPreprocessConfig
create_moses_preprocess_config: create a MosesPreprocessConfig dataclass with lang, shards, output_dir, and normalization flags
get_moses_commands: get a list of Moses Perl script commands based on config flags and language
download_moses_script: download and cache a Moses decoder Perl script from GitHub using get_moses_script
resolve_moses_dir: resolve the local directory path where Moses scripts are cached using resolve_moses_dir
